  tween(7000, EASE.linear, (v) => gridAxes.setAttribute("stroke-dashoffset", String(v * 20.5)), { loop: true, shouldRun: visible });
  tween(4200, EASE.outQuad, (v) => {
    ping.setAttribute("r", String(HUB.r + v * 86));
    ping.setAttribute("opacity", String(0.4 * (1 - v) * (1 - v)));
  }, { loop: true, shouldRun: visible });
  // globe meridian
  const meridian = document.getElementById("globeMeridian");
  tween(10000, EASE.linear, (v) => { if (meridian) meridian.setAttribute("rx", String(Math.max(0.5, Math.abs(Math.cos(v * Math.PI * 2)) * 18))); }, { loop: true, shouldRun: visible });

  /* ---- stage fit ---- */
  const TRACK_BOX = (() => {
    let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (const [x, y] of CIRCUIT_PATH) { minX = Math.min(minX, x); minY = Math.min(minY, y); maxX = Math.max(maxX, x); maxY = Math.max(maxY, y); }
    const pad = 46;
    return { x: minX - pad, y: minY - pad, width: maxX - minX + pad * 2, height: maxY - minY + pad * 2 };
  })();
  const fit = () => {
    const w = frame.clientWidth, h = frame.clientHeight;
    if (!w || !h) return;
    let s, tx, ty;
    if (w >= 1024) {
      s = Math.max(w / 1440, h / 800);
      tx = (w - 1440 * s) / 2; ty = (h - 800 * s) / 2;
    } else {
      s = w / TRACK_BOX.width;
      const cx = TRACK_BOX.x + TRACK_BOX.width / 2, cy = TRACK_BOX.y + TRACK_BOX.height / 2;
      tx = w / 2 - cx * s; ty = h / 2 - cy * s;
    }
    stage.style.transform = `translate(${tx}px, ${ty}px) scale(${s})`;
  };
  new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(frame);
  fit();

  /* ---- halftone ---- */
  const palette = {
    dot: parseColor(readToken("--map-dot")), accent: parseColor(readToken("--accent")),
    white: parseColor(readToken("--foreground-on-dark")),
  };
  palette.bright = mixRgb(palette.accent, palette.white, 0.55);
  const index = (() => {
    const { columns, rows, points, count } = DOTS;
    let minI = Infinity, maxI = -Infinity, minJ = Infinity, maxJ = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      if (columns[i] < minI) minI = columns[i]; if (columns[i] > maxI) maxI = columns[i];
      if (rows[i] < minJ) minJ = rows[i]; if (rows[i] > maxJ) maxJ = rows[i];
    }
    const w = maxI - minI + 1, h = maxJ - minJ + 1;
    const cell = new Int32Array(w * h).fill(-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) cell[(rows[i] - minJ) * w + (columns[i] - minI)] = i;
    const dx = Math.cos(WAVE_ANGLE), dy = Math.sin(WAVE_ANGLE);
    const projection = new Float32Array(count);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) projection[i] = points[i * 2] * dx + points[i * 2 + 1] * dy;
    const order = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => i).sort((a, b) => projection[a] - projection[b]);
    const sorted = new Int32Array(order);
    const sortedProjection = Float32Array.from(order, (i) => projection[i]);
    return { cell, w, h, minI, minJ, dx, dy, sorted, sortedProjection, projectionMin: sortedProjection[0], projectionMax: sortedProjection[count - 1] };
  })();
  const level = new Float32Array(DOTS.count);
  const active = new Int32Array(DOTS.count);
  const inList = new Uint8Array(DOTS.count);
  let activeCount = 0, dirty = true, phase = 0, last = 0, spread = 0;
  const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, heat: 0 };
  const target = { x: 0, y: 0, on: false };
  let baked = null;
  let armed = false;
  const dctx = () => dotsCanvas.getContext("2d");

  const draw = () => {
    if (!baked || !dotsCanvas.width) return;
    const context = dctx();
    const scale = dotsCanvas.width / MAP_VIEW.width;
    context.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
    context.clearRect(0, 0, MAP_VIEW.width, MAP_VIEW.height);
    context.drawImage(baked, 0, 0, MAP_VIEW.width, MAP_VIEW.height);
    const { points, columns, rows } = DOTS;
    const box = DOT_RADIUS * 2 + 1;
    const span = 1 - HALFTONE.threshold || 1;
    let drew = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < activeCount; k += 1) {
      const idx = active[k];
      if (level[idx] < HALFTONE.threshold) continue;
      context.clearRect(points[idx * 2] - DOT_RADIUS - 0.5, points[idx * 2 + 1] - DOT_RADIUS - 0.5, box, box);
      drew += 1;
    }
    if (!drew) return;
    for (let k = 0; k < activeCount; k += 1) {
      const idx = active[k];
      const value = level[idx];
      if (value < HALFTONE.threshold) continue;
      if ((columns[idx] + rows[idx]) & 1) continue;
      const t = Math.min(1, (value - HALFTONE.threshold) / span);
      const side = DOT_LATTICE.pitchX * (CHEQUER_SEED + (CHEQUER_FILL - CHEQUER_SEED) * t);
      context.fillStyle = cssRgb(value > 0.8 ? palette.white : value > 0.5 ? palette.bright : mixRgb(palette.accent, palette.bright, value));
      context.fillRect(points[idx * 2] - side / 2, points[idx * 2 + 1] - side / 2, side, side);
    }
  };
  const bake = () => {
    const width = dotsCanvas.clientWidth, height = dotsCanvas.clientHeight;
    if (!width || !height) return;
    const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, MAX_RATIO);
    const w = Math.round(width * ratio), h = Math.round(height * ratio);
    if (dotsCanvas.width !== w || dotsCanvas.height !== h) { dotsCanvas.width = w; dotsCanvas.height = h; }
    baked = baked || document.createElement("canvas");
    baked.width = w; baked.height = h;
    const context = baked.getContext("2d");
    const scale = w / MAP_VIEW.width;
    context.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
    context.clearRect(0, 0, MAP_VIEW.width, MAP_VIEW.height);
    const { points, count } = DOTS;
    context.fillStyle = cssRgb(palette.dot);
    context.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const x = points[i * 2], y = points[i * 2 + 1];
      context.moveTo(x + DOT_RADIUS, y);
      context.arc(x, y, DOT_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    }
    context.fill();
    dirty = true;
    draw();
  };
  new ResizeObserver(bake).observe(dotsCanvas);
  bake();

  const add = (i, value) => {
    if (value <= MIN_LEVEL) return;
    if (value > level[i]) level[i] = value;
    if (!inList[i]) { inList[i] = 1; active[activeCount] = i; activeCount += 1; }
  };
  const addPoint = (sx, sy, heat, reach) => {
    if (heat <= 0.01) return;
    const { cell, w, h, minI, minJ } = index;
    const { points } = DOTS;
    const i0 = Math.floor((sx - reach - DOT_LATTICE.originX) / DOT_LATTICE.pitchX);
    const i1 = Math.ceil((sx + reach - DOT_LATTICE.originX) / DOT_LATTICE.pitchX);
    const j0 = Math.floor((sy - reach - DOT_LATTICE.originY) / DOT_LATTICE.pitchY);
    const j1 = Math.ceil((sy + reach - DOT_LATTICE.originY) / DOT_LATTICE.pitchY);
    for (let j = Math.max(minJ, j0); j <= Math.min(minJ + h - 1, j1); j += 1) {
      const row = (j - minJ) * w;
      for (let i = Math.max(minI, i0); i <= Math.min(minI + w - 1, i1); i += 1) {
        const idx = cell[row + (i - minI)];
        if (idx < 0) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(points[idx * 2] - sx, points[idx * 2 + 1] - sy);
        add(idx, falloff(d / reach) * heat);
      }
    }
  };
  const addReticle = () => {
    if (pointer.heat <= 0.01) return;
    const { cell, w, h, minI, minJ } = index;
    const { points } = DOTS;
    const ci = Math.round((pointer.x - DOT_LATTICE.originX) / DOT_LATTICE.pitchX);
    const cj = Math.round((pointer.y - DOT_LATTICE.originY) / DOT_LATTICE.pitchY);
    const arm = RETICLE_ARM * pointer.heat;
    const reach = RETICLE_OPEN * spread;
    if (reach > 1 && cj >= minJ && cj < minJ + h) {
      const row = (cj - minJ) * w;
      const span = Math.ceil(reach / DOT_LATTICE.pitchX);
      const from = Math.max(minI, ci - span), to = Math.min(minI + w - 1, ci + span);
      for (let i = from; i <= to; i += 1) {
        const idx = cell[row + (i - minI)];
        if (idx < 0) continue;
        add(idx, (1 - Math.abs(points[idx * 2] - pointer.x) / reach) * arm);
      }
    }
    if (reach > 1 && ci >= minI && ci < minI + w) {
      const span = Math.ceil(reach / DOT_LATTICE.pitchY);
      const from = Math.max(minJ, cj - span), to = Math.min(minJ + h - 1, cj + span);
      for (let j = from; j <= to; j += 1) {
        const idx = cell[(j - minJ) * w + (ci - minI)];
        if (idx < 0) continue;
        add(idx, (1 - Math.abs(points[idx * 2 + 1] - pointer.y) / reach) * arm);
      }
    }
    addPoint(pointer.x, pointer.y, pointer.heat, RETICLE_CORE);
  };
  const light = (dt) => {
    addReticle();
    if (HALFTONE.source === "none") return;
    phase = (phase + dt * HALFTONE.waveSpeed) % 1;
    const { sorted, sortedProjection, projectionMin, projectionMax } = index;
    const radius = Math.max(1, HALFTONE.radius);
    const span = projectionMax - projectionMin + radius * 2;
    const centre = projectionMin - radius + phase * span;
    const lo = centre - radius, hi = centre + radius;
    let a = 0, b = sortedProjection.length;
    while (a < b) { const m = (a + b) >> 1; if (sortedProjection[m] < lo) a = m + 1; else b = m; }
    for (let k = a; k < sortedProjection.length; k += 1) {
      const projection = sortedProjection[k];
      if (projection > hi) break;
      add(sorted[k], falloff(Math.abs(projection - centre) / radius));
    }
  };
  const frameTick = () => {
    const now = performance.now();
    const dt = last ? Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000) : 0;
    last = now;
    const wanted = target.on && armed ? POINTER_HEAT : 0;
    if (pointer.heat <= 0.001 && wanted > 0) { pointer.x = target.x; pointer.y = target.y; }
    else if (dt > 0) {
      const px_ = pointer.x, py_ = pointer.y;
      pointer.x = approach(px_, target.x, dt, POINTER_TRAIL);
      pointer.y = approach(py_, target.y, dt, POINTER_TRAIL);
      const speed = Math.hypot(pointer.x - px_, pointer.y - py_) / dt;
      const wantedSpread = Math.max(0, 1 - speed / RETICLE_SETTLE);
      spread = approach(spread, wantedSpread, dt, wantedSpread > spread ? SPREAD_OPEN : SPREAD_SHUT);
    }
    pointer.heat = approach(pointer.heat, wanted, dt, wanted > pointer.heat ? POINTER_RISE : POINTER_FALL);
    if (pointer.heat < 0.005) { pointer.heat = 0; spread = 0; }
    const decay = Math.exp(-dt / Math.max(0.05, HALFTONE.fade / 3));
    let write = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < activeCount; k += 1) {
      const idx = active[k];
      const value = level[idx] * decay;
      if (value > MIN_LEVEL) { level[idx] = value; active[write] = idx; write += 1; }
      else { level[idx] = 0; inList[idx] = 0; }
    }
    const before = activeCount;
    activeCount = write;
    light(dt);
    if (activeCount === 0 && before === 0 && !dirty) return;
    dirty = false;
    draw();
  };
  tween(CLOCK_MS, EASE.linear, frameTick, { loop: true, shouldRun: visible });

  /* pointer → map units; mouse only, never under hover:none or reduced motion */
  if (!window.matchMedia("(hover: none)").matches && !REDUCED_MOTION) {
    window.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType && e.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
      const r = dotsCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const sr = section.getBoundingClientRect();
      const inside = e.clientX >= sr.left && e.clientX <= sr.right && e.clientY >= sr.top && e.clientY <= sr.bottom;
      target.on = inside && r.width > 0;
      if (target.on) {
        target.x = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * MAP_VIEW.width;
        target.y = ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * MAP_VIEW.height;
      }
    }, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { target.on = false; });
    window.addEventListener("blur", () => { target.on = false; });
  }

  /* ---- the lap ---- */
  const tctx = trace.getContext("2d");
  const tratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, MAX_RATIO);
  trace.width = Math.round(1440 * tratio); trace.height = Math.round(800 * tratio);
  const tpal = { accent: palette.accent, white: palette.white, bright: palette.bright };
  let heat = 1;
  let lapProgress = 0;
  const stroke = (context, points, from = 0) => {
    context.beginPath();
    context.moveTo(points[from][0], points[from][1]);
    for (let i = from + 1; i < points.length; i += 1) context.lineTo(points[i][0], points[i][1]);
    context.stroke();
  };
  const drawTrail = (context, points, minWidth, glow, h) => {
    if (points.length < 2) return;
    const width = Math.max(minWidth, LINE_WIDTH);
    context.lineCap = "round"; context.lineJoin = "round";
    if (glow) {
      context.save();
      context.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      context.strokeStyle = rgba(tpal.accent, 0.05); context.lineWidth = GLOW_WIDTH; stroke(context, points);
      context.strokeStyle = rgba(tpal.accent, 0.1); context.lineWidth = GLOW_WIDTH * 0.45; stroke(context, points);
      context.restore();
    }
    const head = Math.max(2, Math.round(HEAD_UNITS / CIRCUIT_STEP));
    const from = Math.max(0, points.length - head);
    const tip = points[points.length - 1];
    const hot = context.createLinearGradient(points[from][0], points[from][1], tip[0], tip[1]);
    hot.addColorStop(0, rgba(tpal.accent, 0));
    hot.addColorStop(0.45, rgba(tpal.accent, 0.9));
    hot.addColorStop(1, rgba(mixRgb(tpal.accent, tpal.bright, h), 1));
    context.strokeStyle = hot; context.lineWidth = width; stroke(context, points, from);
    const coreFrom = Math.max(0, points.length - Math.round(head * 0.42));
    if (points.length - coreFrom > 1) {
      const core = context.createLinearGradient(points[coreFrom][0], points[coreFrom][1], tip[0], tip[1]);
      core.addColorStop(0, rgba(tpal.bright, 0));
      core.addColorStop(1, rgba(tpal.white, 0.95 * h));
      context.strokeStyle = core; context.lineWidth = Math.max(minWidth * 0.6, width * 0.38); stroke(context, points, coreFrom);
    }
  };
  const renderLap = (progress) => {
    lapProgress = progress;
    const distance = distanceAtTime(progress);
    const points = trailUpTo(distance);
    const context = tctx;
    context.setTransform(tratio, 0, 0, tratio, 0, 0);
    context.clearRect(0, 0, 1440, 800);
    if (points.length > 1) {
      drawTrail(context, points, 0.6, true, heat);
      const [tx, ty] = points[points.length - 1];
      context.save(); context.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      const spark = context.createRadialGradient(tx, ty, 0, tx, ty, LINE_WIDTH * 2.6);
      spark.addColorStop(0, rgba(tpal.white, 0.85 * heat));
      spark.addColorStop(0.35, rgba(tpal.bright, 0.4 * heat));
      spark.addColorStop(1, rgba(tpal.accent, 0));
      context.fillStyle = spark; context.beginPath(); context.arc(tx, ty, LINE_WIDTH * 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); context.fill();
      context.restore();
    }
    context.save(); context.translate(CUT_CENTRE[0], CUT_CENTRE[1]); context.rotate((FLAG_CUT.angle * Math.PI) / 180);
    context.clearRect(-CUT_ALONG / 2, -CUT_ACROSS / 2, CUT_ALONG, CUT_ACROSS); context.restore();
    for (const marker of CIRCUIT_MARKERS) {
      if (distance < marker.d) continue;
      const age = Math.min(1, (distance - marker.d) / MARKER_POP_UNITS);
      const radius = 12 + (1 - age) * 14;
      const glow = context.createRadialGradient(marker.x, marker.y, 0, marker.x, marker.y, radius);
      glow.addColorStop(0, rgba(tpal.bright, 0.5 + 0.45 * (1 - age)));
      glow.addColorStop(0.45, rgba(tpal.accent, 0.32));
      glow.addColorStop(1, rgba(tpal.accent, 0));
      context.save(); context.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter"; context.fillStyle = glow;
      context.beginPath(); context.arc(marker.x, marker.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); context.fill(); context.restore();
      if (age < 1) {
        context.strokeStyle = rgba(tpal.bright, (1 - age) * 0.6); context.lineWidth = 1;
        context.beginPath(); context.arc(marker.x, marker.y, 9 + age * 20, 0, Math.PI * 2); context.stroke();
      }
    }
    const reveal = 1 - distance / TOTAL;
    lapMaskPath.setAttribute("stroke-dashoffset", String(60 + reveal * LAP_LENGTH));
  };
  renderLap(0);
  let lapStarted = false;
  const lapIo = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (!e.isIntersecting || lapStarted) continue;
      lapStarted = true;
      lapIo.disconnect();
      const duration = REDUCED_MOTION ? 1 : LAP_MS;
      tween(duration, EASE.inOutSine, (v) => renderLap(v), {
        onDone: () => {
          tween(COOL_MS, EASE.outCubic, (v) => { heat = 1 - v; renderLap(1); }, { onDone: () => { heat = 0; renderLap(1); armed = true; } });
        },
      });
    }
  }, { threshold: 0.35 });
  lapIo.observe(frame);
}

/* =====================================================================
   8. TIMELINE, PADDOCK, FOOTER — builders & transitions
   ===================================================================== */
const ARROW_PATH = "M0 5.35H13M8 10.35L13 5.35L8 0.35";
const BRK_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 10.5 10.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0 0.5H10V10.5"/></svg>';
const bracketsHtml = (cls, style = "", attrs = "") =>
  `<div class="brk ${cls}" style="${style}" ${attrs}><i class="c-tl">${BRK_SVG}</i><i class="c-tr">${BRK_SVG}</i><i class="c-br">${BRK_SVG}</i><i class="c-bl">${BRK_SVG}</i></div>`;
const rvLetters = (text, { s = 22, d = 0, cfg = "ROW", gate = "view", mode = "forward", sel = "", rm = "" } = {}) =>
  `<span class="rv rv-nowrap" data-rv="l" data-s="${s}" data-d="${d}" data-cfg="${cfg}" data-mode="${mode}" data-gate="${gate}" ${sel ? `data-gate-sel="${sel}"` : ""} ${rm ? `data-rm="${rm}"` : ""} data-gap="0" data-text="${text}"></span>`;
const rvWords = (text, { s = 110, d = 0, cfg = "REVEAL", gate = "view", mode = "forward", gap = "", aria = false } = {}) =>
  `<span class="rv" data-rv="w" data-s="${s}" data-d="${d}" data-cfg="${cfg}" data-mode="${mode}" data-gate="${gate}" ${gap ? `data-gap="${gap}"` : ""} ${aria ? "data-aria" : ""} data-text="${text}"></span>`;
const buttonHtml = ({ href, label, solid, ratioW, style = "", id = "" }) => {
  const W = Math.round(ratioW * 50 * 1000) / 1000;
  const cut = 8.835;
  const path = `M0.5 0.5H${W - 0.5}V${50 - cut}L${W - cut} 49.5H0.5Z`;
  return `<a class="btn" href="${href}" style="${style}" ${id ? `id="${id}"` : ""}>
    <svg class="frame" viewBox="0 0 ${W} 50" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="${path}" style="fill:${solid ? "var(--surface-black)" : "none"};stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:1;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke"/>
      <path class="flood" d="${path}" style="fill:var(--accent)"/>
    </svg>
    <span class="lab">${label}<svg viewBox="0 0 13.71 10.71" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${ARROW_PATH}"/></svg></span></a>`;
};

/* ---- contour backdrop (marching squares on a 2D canvas) ---- */
function createContour(canvas, token) {
  const LINE_SCALE = 3.8, LINE_COUNT = 2.5, WAVE_AMOUNT = 0.37, WAVE_SPEED = 1.66, LINE_OPACITY = 0.85, CELLS = 96;
  const field = (x, y, t) => {
    let f = Math.sin(x * 1.0 + t * 0.6) * 0.5;
    f += Math.sin(y * 0.85 - t * 0.45) * 0.45;
    f += Math.sin((x + y) * 0.65 + t * 0.35) * 0.35;
    f += Math.sin((x - y) * 0.95 - t * 0.55) * 0.25;
    return f * 0.5 + 0.5;
  };
  const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const colour = readToken(token);
  const start = performance.now();
  let values = new Float32Array(0);
  let visibleNow = false;
  new IntersectionObserver((e) => { for (const x of e) visibleNow = x.isIntersecting; }).observe(canvas);
  const draw = (now) => {
    const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
    if (!w || !h) return;
    const bw = Math.round(w * ratio), bh = Math.round(h * ratio);
    if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) { canvas.width = bw; canvas.height = bh; }
    context.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    context.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const t = ((now - start) / 1000) * WAVE_SPEED;
    const cols = w >= h ? CELLS : Math.max(8, Math.round((CELLS * w) / h));
    const rows = Math.max(8, Math.round((cols * h) / w));
    const stepX = w / cols, stepY = h / rows, aspect = w / h;
    const need = (cols + 1) * (rows + 1);
    if (values.length !== need) values = new Float32Array(need);
    for (let j = 0; j <= rows; j += 1) for (let i = 0; i <= cols; i += 1) {
      const nx = ((i / cols) * 2 - 1) * aspect * LINE_SCALE;
      const ny = ((j / rows) * 2 - 1) * LINE_SCALE;
      const qx = nx + Math.sin(ny * 0.8 + t * 0.7) * WAVE_AMOUNT;
      const qy = ny + Math.cos(nx * 0.7 - t * 0.6) * WAVE_AMOUNT;
      values[j * (cols + 1) + i] = field(qx, qy, t) * LINE_COUNT;
    }
    context.strokeStyle = colour; context.lineWidth = 1; context.globalAlpha = LINE_OPACITY; context.beginPath();
    const seg = (p, q) => { context.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); context.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); };
    for (let level = 0.5; level < LINE_COUNT; level += 1) {
      for (let j = 0; j < rows; j += 1) for (let i = 0; i < cols; i += 1) {
        const a = values[j * (cols + 1) + i], b = values[j * (cols + 1) + i + 1];
        const c = values[(j + 1) * (cols + 1) + i + 1], d = values[(j + 1) * (cols + 1) + i];
        const index = (a > level ? 8 : 0) | (b > level ? 4 : 0) | (c > level ? 2 : 0) | (d > level ? 1 : 0);
        if (index === 0 || index === 15) continue;
        const x0 = i * stepX, y0 = j * stepY;
        const top = [x0 + stepX * ((level - a) / (b - a)), y0];
        const right = [x0 + stepX, y0 + stepY * ((level - b) / (c - b))];
        const bottom = [x0 + stepX * ((level - d) / (c - d)), y0 + stepY];
        const left = [x0, y0 + stepY * ((level - a) / (d - a))];
        switch (index) {
          case 1: case 14: seg(left, bottom); break;
          case 2: case 13: seg(bottom, right); break;
          case 3: case 12: seg(left, right); break;
          case 4: case 11: seg(top, right); break;
          case 6: case 9: seg(top, bottom); break;
          case 7: case 8: seg(left, top); break;
          case 5: seg(left, top); seg(bottom, right); break;
          case 10: seg(left, bottom); seg(top, right); break;
          default: break;
        }
      }
    }
    context.stroke(); context.globalAlpha = 1;
  };
  if (REDUCED_MOTION) {
    draw(start);
    new ResizeObserver(() => draw(start)).observe(canvas);
  } else {
    subscribe((time) => { if (visibleNow && !document.hidden) draw(time); }, () => 24);
  }
}

/* ---- TIMELINE ---- */
const TL = {
  ROW: { side: 217, centre: 462 }, PLATE_W: { side: 333, centre: 710 }, TOP_PAD: 169,
  MARK_RISE: 50, MARK_SIZE: 9, MARK_SIZE_NARROW: 20, RAIL_SOLID: 98, RAIL_GAP: 4, RAIL_DASH: 6,
  PARALLAX: { plate: { side: 60, centre: 20 }, copy: 110 }, COPY_LEFT: 1020, YEAR_HOLD: 2200, YEAR_RESTING: 0.4,
};
const TIMELINE = [
  { year: "2022", img: "01", frame: "centre", lead: "Le déclic.", rest: "Devant ma machine, le code devient une passion et le point de départ d'un vrai métier.", w: 228, alt: "Authentique devant sa machine, en 2022" },
  { year: "2023", img: "02", frame: "side", align: "right", alt: "Mon espace de travail et mon setup" },
  { year: "2024", img: "03", frame: "centre", lead: "L'université.", rest: "Licence 3 en génie logiciel à l'Université Aube Nouvelle de Bobo-Dioulasso : rigueur et solutions concrètes.", w: 272, alt: "Authentique à la bibliothèque universitaire" },
  { year: "2024", img: "04", frame: "side", align: "left", alt: "Un MacBook et un livre ouvert : Have a plan" },
  { year: "2025", img: "05", frame: "centre", lead: "Transmettre.", rest: "Leader des Dév-Innovateurs du Burkina, je fédère une communauté autour du développement et de l'innovation.", w: 278, alt: "Authentique donnant une formation en Python" },
  { year: "2025", img: "06", frame: "side", align: "right", alt: "Authentique au bureau devant son ordinateur" },
  { year: "2026", img: "07", frame: "centre", lead: "Authentique.", rest: "Fondateur d'Authentique Studio et cofondateur d'Allo Gaz, meilleur ingénieur en IA de mon université en 2025.", w: 284, alt: "Portrait d'Authentique de profil" },
];
const ROW_RM = "0% 0% -25% 0%";

function buildTimeline() {
  const mount = document.getElementById("timelineMount");
  const rowsHtml = TIMELINE.map((e, i) => {
    const centre = e.frame === "centre";
    const h = TL.ROW[e.frame];
    const dir = i % 2 === 0 ? "l" : "r";
    const plateStyle = centre
      ? `width:${px(TL.PLATE_W.centre)};left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)`
      : `width:${px(TL.PLATE_W.side)};${e.align === "left" ? "left:var(--gutter)" : "right:var(--gutter)"}`;
    const copy = centre ? `
      <div class="tl-copy" style="left:${px(TL.COPY_LEFT)};top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:min(max(${px(e.w)}, var(--copy-min-w, 0px)), var(--copy-max-w, 100vw));font-size:max(${px(18)}, var(--copy-min-size, 0px))">
        <div data-rise="0.75rem" data-d="220" data-gate="once" data-gate-sel=".tl-row" data-rm="${ROW_RM}" data-cfg="COPY"><div class="tl-copy-in" data-copy-in><p><b>${e.lead}</b> ${e.rest}</p></div></div>
      </div>` : "";
    return `<article class="tl-row" style="height:${px(h)}" data-row data-frame="${e.frame}">
      <div class="tl-plate ${dir}" style="${plateStyle}" data-plate>
        <div class="tl-plate-in" data-plate-in>
          <div class="tl-fill"><div class="tl-fill-slot" data-slot><img data-asset="timeline/${e.img}.webp" alt="${e.alt}" width="1420" height="1016" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div></div>
          <svg class="tl-outline" viewBox="0 0 710.995 462.995" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${PLATE_OUTLINE}"/></svg>
          <div class="tl-year disp" data-year>${rvLetters(e.year, { s: 26, cfg: "YEAR", gate: "once", sel: ".tl-row", rm: ROW_RM })}</div>
        </div>
      </div>${copy}</article>`;
  }).join("");
  mount.innerHTML = `<section class="tl" id="timeline" aria-labelledby="tlH">
    <div class="seam" data-seam="light" aria-hidden="true"><canvas></canvas></div>
    <div class="tl-wrap" id="tlWrap">
      <h2 class="tl-h disp" id="tlH"><span class="sr-only">du code au studio.</span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" style="display:block">${rvWords("du code", { d: 0, aria: true })}</span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" style="display:flex">${rvWords("au studio", { d: 130, aria: true })}<span data-fade data-d="240" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" style="color:#fff">.</span></span>
      </h2>
      <div class="tl-rail" id="tlRail" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      ${rowsHtml}
    </div>
    <div style="height:var(--bottom-pad)"></div>
  </section>`;
  const section = $("#timeline", mount);
  const wrap = $("#tlWrap", mount);
  const rail = $("#tlRail", mount);

  /* parallax layers + plate slot scrub + hover dim */
  const canHover = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover)").matches && !REDUCED_MOTION;
  for (const row of $$("[data-row]", mount)) {
    const frame = row.dataset.frame;
    const plate = $("[data-plate]", row), plateIn = $("[data-plate-in]", row), slot = $("[data-slot]", row);
    const travel = TL.PARALLAX.plate[frame];
    scrollTrigger(row, "top bottom", "bottom top", (p) => { plateIn.style.top = lerpUnit(px(travel), px(-travel), p); });
    const copyIn = $("[data-copy-in]", row);
    if (copyIn) scrollTrigger(row, "top bottom", "bottom top", (p) => { copyIn.style.top = lerpUnit(px(TL.PARALLAX.copy), px(-TL.PARALLAX.copy), p); });
    scrollTrigger(plate, "top bottom", "top center", (p) => { slot.style.top = `${-10 * (1 - p)}%`; });
    if (canHover) {
      plate.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => { row.classList.add("hov"); section.classList.add("dim"); });
      plate.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { row.classList.remove("hov"); section.classList.remove("dim"); });
    }
    if (frame === "centre") {
      const yr = $(".tl-year", row);
      const settle = new Spring(1, CFG.YEAR_SETTLE, (v) => { yr.style.opacity = String(v); });
      const gate = makeOnceGate(row, ROW_RM);
      gate.listen(() => setTimeout(() => settle.to(TL.YEAR_RESTING), TL.YEAR_HOLD));
    }
  }

  /* rail: track, progress, rotating marker */
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const svg = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMin meet");
  rail.appendChild(svg);
  const mk = (tag, attrs) => { const el = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (const k in attrs) el.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); svg.appendChild(el); return el; };
  const solid = mk("line", { x1: 8, x2: 8, y1: 0, y2: TL.RAIL_SOLID, style: "stroke:var(--timeline-rail);stroke-width:1" });
  const dashed = mk("line", { x1: 8, x2: 8, y1: TL.RAIL_SOLID + TL.RAIL_GAP, y2: 0, style: "stroke:var(--timeline-rail);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:6 6" });
  const prog = mk("rect", { x: 7.5, y: 0, width: 1, height: 0, style: "fill:var(--foreground-on-dark)" });
  const mark = mk("rect", { x: -4.5, y: -4.5, width: 9, height: 9, style: "fill:#fff" });
  let rest = 1, run = 0;
  const paint = () => {
    prog.setAttribute("height", String(run));
    mark.setAttribute("transform", `translate(8 ${run}) rotate(${rest ? (run / rest) * 1800 : 0})`);
  };
  const measure = () => {
    const w = rail.clientWidth, h = rail.clientHeight;
    if (!w || !h) return;
    const viewH = (h * 16) / w;
    const size = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 1023px)").matches ? TL.MARK_SIZE_NARROW : TL.MARK_SIZE;
    rest = Math.max(1, viewH - (TL.ROW.centre / 2 + TL.MARK_RISE));
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 16 ${viewH}`);
    dashed.setAttribute("y2", String(rest));
    mark.setAttribute("x", String(-size / 2)); mark.setAttribute("y", String(-size / 2));
    mark.setAttribute("width", String(size)); mark.setAttribute("height", String(size));
    solid.setAttribute("y2", String(Math.min(TL.RAIL_SOLID, rest)));
    paint();
  };
  new ResizeObserver(measure).observe(rail);
  measure();
  const railSpring = new Spring(0, CFG.TRIGGER, (v) => { run = v * rest; paint(); });
  scrollTrigger(rail, "top center", "bottom bottom", (p) => railSpring.to(p));
  new ResizeObserver(() => railSpring.jump(railSpring.value)).observe(rail);
}

/* ---- PADDOCK ---- */
const CAL = [
  { round: "projet 01", name: "boutik", date: "web", x: 347, w: 100, mark: "web", href: "https://github.com/AUthENTIQUEyeager/boutik-os" },
  { round: "projet 02", name: "bot telegram", date: "outil", x: 511, w: 100, mark: "bot", href: "https://github.com/AUthENTIQUEyeager/bot-telegram" },
  { round: "projet 03", name: "allo-gaz", date: "cofondateur", x: 675, w: 100, live: true, href: "https://allo-gaz-bf.vercel.app/" },
  { round: "projet 04", name: "bmw m3 e30", date: "modèle 3d", x: 839, w: 114, ring: true, href: "https://bmwmtroisetrente.netlify.app/" },
  { round: "studio", name: "authentique", date: "fondateur", x: 1017, w: 76, ring: true },
];
const CAL_LINKS = [{ x: 416, w: 126, dir: 1 }, { x: 580, w: 128, dir: 1 }, { x: 743, w: 136, dir: -1 }, { x: 914, w: 124, dir: -1 }];
const PAD_STATS = [
  ["paddock/icon-flag.svg", "formation", "L3"], ["paddock/icon-bars.svg", "prix ia", "2025"],
  ["paddock/icon-trophy.svg", "projets", "4"], ["paddock/icon-gauge.svg", "rôle", "LEAD"],
];
const CAL_START = 560, CAL_STAGGER = 90;
const spreadX = (x) => `calc(50% + ${px(x - 720)} * var(--cal-spread, 1))`;

function buildPaddock() {
  const mount = document.getElementById("paddockMount");
  const sel = ".pad";
  const cardHtml = CAL.map((c, i) => `
    <div class="cal-card ${c.live ? "live" : ""}" style="left:calc(${spreadX(c.x + c.w / 2)} - ${px(c.w / 2)});width:var(--cal-card-w, ${px(c.w)})" data-rise="0.5rem" data-d="${CAL_START + i * CAL_STAGGER}" data-gate="once" data-gate-sel=".cal" data-rm="0% 0% -20% 0%" data-cfg="REVEAL" ${c.live ? 'id="liveCard"' : ""}>
      <span class="cal-round">${c.round}</span>
      <span class="cal-name" data-rise="0.3em" data-d="${CAL_START + i * CAL_STAGGER + 110}" data-gate="once" data-gate-sel=".cal" data-rm="0% 0% -20% 0%" data-cfg="NAME">${c.href ? `<a class="cal-a" href="${c.href}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Ouvrir le projet ${c.name}">${c.name}</a>` : c.name}</span>
      <span class="cal-date">${c.date}</span>
    </div>`).join("");
  const marksHtml = CAL.map((c, i) => {
    const inner = c.mark ? c.mark
      : c.live ? '<svg viewBox="-5.5 -5.5 11 11" aria-hidden="true"><circle id="livePulse" r="5.5" fill="none" style="stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:1;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke" opacity="0"/><circle r="5.5" style="fill:var(--accent)"/></svg>'
        : '<svg viewBox="-5.5 -5.5 11 11" aria-hidden="true"><circle r="5" fill="none" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1"/></svg>';
    return `<div class="cal-mark" style="left:${spreadX(c.x + c.w / 2)}" data-fade data-d="${CAL_START + i * CAL_STAGGER + 60}" data-gate="once" data-gate-sel=".cal" data-rm="0% 0% -20% 0%">${inner}</div>`;
  }).join("");
  const linksHtml = CAL_LINKS.map((l, i) => `<div class="cal-link abs" data-link="${l.dir}" style="position:absolute;left:${spreadX(l.x)};width:calc(${px(l.w)} * var(--cal-spread, 1))" data-rule data-d="${CAL_START + i * CAL_STAGGER}" data-gate="once" data-gate-sel=".cal" data-rm="0% 0% -20% 0%" data-cfg="REVEAL"></div>`).join("");
  const gridHtml = CAL.slice(-3).map((c) => `<div class="cal-card ${c.live ? "live" : ""}"><span class="cal-round">${c.round}</span><span class="cal-name">${c.name}</span><span class="cal-date">${c.date}</span></div>`).join("");
  const statsHtml = PAD_STATS.map(([icon, label, fig], r) => `
    ${r ? `<div class="st-rule" data-rule data-d="${460 + r * 90}" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" data-cfg="REVEAL"></div>` : ""}
    <div class="st-row" data-rise="0.75rem" data-d="${460 + r * 90 + 40}" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" data-cfg="REVEAL">
      <img data-asset="${icon}" alt="" aria-hidden="true" crossorigin="anonymous">
      <div><span class="st-lab">${label}</span><span class="st-fig">${rvLetters(fig, { s: 24, d: 460 + r * 90 + 120, cfg: "FIGURE" })}</span></div>
    </div>`).join("");

  mount.innerHTML = `<section class="pad" id="paddock" aria-labelledby="padH">
    <canvas class="contour" id="padContour" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
    <div class="pad-band"></div>
    <div class="pad-fig-layer" aria-hidden="false"><div class="fig-lay" id="padFig"><img data-asset="paddock/portrait.webp" width="1254" height="1254" alt="Authentique en costume" crossorigin="anonymous"></div></div>
    <div class="pad-fade"></div>
    <div class="seam" data-seam="dark" aria-hidden="true"><canvas></canvas></div>
    <h2 class="pad-h" id="padH"><span class="sr-only">mes projets.</span>
      <span class="line" aria-hidden="true">${rvWords("mes", { d: 0, aria: true })}</span>
      <span class="line" aria-hidden="true">${rvWords("projets", { d: 130, aria: true })}<span data-fade data-d="240" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" style="color:var(--accent)">.</span></span>
    </h2>
    <div class="pad-intro">
      <p class="pad-report">${rvWords("Allo-Gaz, Boutik, un bot Telegram, une BMW M3 E30 en 3D : des solutions concrètes, du besoin à l'application.", { s: 30, d: 350, cfg: "INTRO", gap: "0.22" })}</p>
      <div data-rise="0.75rem" data-d="${2 * 130 + 260}" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" data-cfg="REVEAL"><div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:calc(var(--cta-h, 3.4722cqw) * 0.3)">${buttonHtml({ href: "https://github.com/authentiquestudioweb/", label: "github", solid: true, ratioW: 4.34 })}${buttonHtml({ href: "cv/", label: "cv gratuit", solid: true, ratioW: 5.2 })}</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pnl pnl-hide" id="padPanels">
      ${bracketsHtml("meet-brk", "", `data-fade data-d="320" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward"`)}
      <dl class="meet-col" data-rise="0.75rem" data-d="410" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" data-cfg="REVEAL"><dt class="sr-only">Basé à</dt><dd><b>authentique studio</b></dd><dd>ouagadougou</dd><dd>burkina faso</dd></dl>
      ${bracketsHtml("stats-brk", "", `data-fade data-d="460" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward"`)}
      <div class="stats-col">${statsHtml}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="cal" id="cal">
      <div class="cal-strip" style="position:absolute;inset:0">
        ${linksHtml}${cardHtml}${marksHtml}
        ${bracketsHtml("live-brk", `left:${spreadX(669)};width:calc(${px(112)} * var(--cal-spread, 1));top:calc(${px(32)} + var(--bracket-drop, 0px));height:calc(${px(81)} + var(--bracket-stretch, 0px));--bu:${px(10)}`, `data-fade data-d="${CAL_START + 5 * CAL_STAGGER}" data-gate="once" data-gate-sel=".cal" data-rm="0% 0% -20% 0%"`)}
      </div>
      <div class="cal-grid" aria-label="Upcoming rounds">${gridHtml}</div>
    </div>
  </section>`;
  const section = $("#paddock", mount);
  createContour($("#padContour", mount), "--paddock-contour");
  createSeam($(".seam", section), "dark");
  const fig = $("#padFig", mount);
  scrollTrigger(section, "top bottom", "bottom top", (p) => { fig.style.top = lerpUnit("0cqw", "-3.3333cqw", p); });

  /* calendar: connector crawl, live pulse, bracket hover */
  const cal = $("#cal", mount);
  const links = $$("[data-link]", cal);
  let calVisible = false;
  new IntersectionObserver((e) => { for (const x of e) calVisible = x.isIntersecting; }).observe(cal);
  const phone = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 639px)");
  tween(5200, EASE.linear, (v) => {
    for (const l of links) l.style.backgroundPositionX = `${v * Number(l.dataset.link) * (11.45 / 14.4)}cqw`;
  }, { loop: true, shouldRun: () => calVisible && !phone.matches });
  const pulse = $("#livePulse", cal);
  tween(3200, EASE.outQuad, (v) => {
    if (!pulse) return;
    pulse.setAttribute("r", String(5.5 + v * 5.5 * 3.4));
    pulse.setAttribute("opacity", String(0.5 * (1 - v) * (1 - v)));
  }, { loop: true, shouldRun: () => calVisible && !phone.matches });
  const live = $("#liveCard", cal);
  if (live) {
    live.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => cal.style.setProperty("--bracket-spread", px(5)));
    live.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => cal.style.removeProperty("--bracket-spread"));
  }
}

/* ---- FOOTER ---- */
const FOOT_NAV = [["accueil", "#main"], ["parcours", "#season"], ["histoire", "#timeline"], ["projets", "#paddock"], ["contact", "mailto:authentique.studio.web@gmail.com"]];
function buildFooter() {
  const mount = document.getElementById("footerMount");
  const nav = FOOT_NAV.map(([l, h], i) => `<a class="nav-link" href="${h}" aria-label="${l}">${rvLetters(l, { s: 22, d: 260 + i * 80, cfg: "ROW" }).replace('data-text="' + l + '"', 'data-text="' + l + '" data-aria')}</a>`).join("");
  mount.innerHTML = `<footer class="foot" id="footer" aria-label="Footer">
    <div class="foot-panel"><canvas class="contour" id="footContour" aria-hidden="true"></canvas></div>
    <div class="foot-fig fig-group" aria-hidden="false"><div class="fig-lay" id="footFig">
      <img class="foot-figure" data-asset="footer/figure.webp" alt="Authentique, en costume" width="1400" height="1400" crossorigin="anonymous">
    </div></div>
    <div class="foot-logo" role="img" aria-label="Authentique Studio" data-fade data-d="120" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward"></div>
    <h2 class="foot-h foot-masthead"><span class="sr-only">construisons ensemble.</span>
      <span class="line" aria-hidden="true">${rvWords("construisons", { d: 0, aria: true })}</span>
      <span class="line" aria-hidden="true">${rvWords("ensemble", { d: 130, aria: true })}<span data-fade data-d="240" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" style="color:#fff">.</span></span>
    </h2>
    <nav class="foot-nav" aria-label="Footer">${nav}</nav>
    <p class="foot-row foot-copy" data-rise="0.75rem" data-d="640" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" data-cfg="REVEAL">© 2026 Authentique Studio. Tous droits réservés.</p>
    <div class="foot-row foot-cta" data-rise="0.75rem" data-d="720" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" data-cfg="REVEAL">${buttonHtml({ href: "https://wa.me/22665189025", label: "whatsapp", solid: true, ratioW: 5.5 })}</div>
    <div class="foot-row foot-soc" data-rise="0.75rem" data-d="800" data-gate="view" data-mode="forward" data-cfg="REVEAL"><a href="https://github.com/authentiquestudioweb/" rel="noopener">github</a><a href="https://wa.me/22665189025" rel="noopener">whatsapp</a><a href="mailto:authentique.studio.web@gmail.com">mail</a></div>
  </footer>`;
  const section = $("#footer", mount);
  createContour($("#footContour", mount), "--footer-contour");
  const fig = $("#footFig", mount);
  scrollTrigger(section, "top bottom", "bottom bottom", (p) => { fig.style.top = lerpUnit(px(60), "0cqw", p); });
}

/* =====================================================================
   10. INITIALISATION, LOADING & CLEAN-UP
   ===================================================================== */
function safely(label, fn) {
  try { return fn(); } catch (err) { console.error(`[init:${label}] failed`, err); return undefined; }
}
window.addEventListener("error", (e) => console.error("[window.error]", e.message, e.filename, e.lineno));
window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e) => console.error("[unhandledrejection]", e.reason));

function boot() {
  wireAssets();
  safely("timeline", buildTimeline);
  safely("paddock", buildPaddock);
  safely("footer", buildFooter);
  wireAssets();
  safely("stack", initStack);
  safely("menu", initMenu);
  safely("season", initSeason);
  safely("season-seam", () => createSeam(document.getElementById("seasonSeam"), "light"));
  safely("timeline-seam", () => createSeam($("#timeline .seam"), "light"));
  safely("reveals", () => initAllReveals());
  safely("hero", initHero);
  // fonts / late layout: recompute scroll metrics once everything settled
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(() => { if (lenis) lenis.resize(); });
  window.addEventListener("load", () => { if (lenis) lenis.resize(); }, { once: true });
  window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => { if (lenis) lenis.destroy(); }, { once: true });
}
boot();
</script>
</body>
</html>

/* =====================================================================
   3. SHARED TICKER & SPRING ENGINE
   ===================================================================== */
const tickerSubs = new Set();
const tickerSnapshot = [];
let tickerRaf = 0;
function tickerLoop(time) {
  tickerRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tickerLoop);
  tickerSnapshot.length = 0;
  for (const s of tickerSubs) tickerSnapshot.push(s);
  for (let i = 0; i < tickerSnapshot.length; i += 1) {
    const s = tickerSnapshot[i];
    if (!tickerSubs.has(s)) continue;
    if (time - s.last > s.getFramerate()) {
      s.last = time;
      try { s.callback(time); } catch (err) { console.error("[ticker] subscriber threw", err); }
    }

}
function subscribe(callback, getFramerate = () => 0) {
  const sub = { callback, getFramerate, last: -Infinity };
  tickerSubs.add(sub);
  if (!tickerRaf) tickerRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tickerLoop);
  return () => {
    tickerSubs.delete(sub);
    if (!tickerSubs.size && tickerRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(tickerRaf); tickerRaf = 0; }
  };
}

/* Lenis — registered first so every scroll reader sees this frame's scrollY */
let lenis = null;
if (!REDUCED_MOTION) {

  subscribe((time) => lenis.raf(time), () => 0);

  st.textContent = "html.lenis,html.lenis body{height:auto}.lenis.lenis-smooth{scroll-behavior:auto!important}.lenis.lenis-stopped{overflow:hidden}";
  document.head.appendChild(st);

/* spring: react-spring's damped solver, mass 1, 1ms substeps, 64ms frame cap */
const activeSprings = new Set();
let springUnsub = null;
function springFrame(time) {
  for (const s of Array.from(activeSprings)) s.step(time);
  if (!activeSprings.size && springUnsub) { springUnsub(); springUnsub = null; }
}
class Spring {
  constructor(value, cfg, onUpdate, precision = 0.001) {
    this.value = value; this.velocity = 0; this.target = value; this.cfg = cfg;
    this.onUpdate = onUpdate; this.precision = precision; this.startAt = 0; this.lastTime = 0;
  }
  to(target, delay = 0, cfg) {
    if (cfg) this.cfg = cfg;
    if (REDUCED_MOTION) { this.jump(target); return; }
    if (target === this.target && !activeSprings.has(this) && this.value === target) return;
    this.target = target;
    this.startAt = performance.now() + delay;
    this.lastTime = 0;
    activeSprings.add(this);
    if (!springUnsub) springUnsub = subscribe(springFrame, () => 0);
  }
  jump(value) {
    this.value = value; this.target = value; this.velocity = 0; activeSprings.delete(this);
    this.onUpdate(value);
  }
  step(time) {
    if (time < this.startAt) return;
    const last = this.lastTime || time;
    this.lastTime = time;
    const dt = Math.min(64, Math.max(0, time - last));
    const [tension, friction] = this.cfg;
    let { value, velocity } = this;
    for (let i = 0; i < dt; i += 1) {
      const accel = -tension * (value - this.target) - friction * velocity;
      velocity += accel * 0.001;
      value += velocity * 0.001;
    }
    if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.01 && Math.abs(this.target - value) < this.precision) {
      value = this.target; velocity = 0; activeSprings.delete(this);
    }
    this.value = value; this.velocity = velocity;
    this.onUpdate(value);
  }
}

/* plain tween driven by the ticker */
const EASE = {
  linear: (t) => t, outQuad: (t) => 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t), outCubic: (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3),
  inOutSine: (t) => -(Math.cos(Math.PI * t) - 1) / 2,
};
function tween(duration, easing, onUpdate, { loop = false, shouldRun = () => true, onDone } = {}) {
  if (REDUCED_MOTION && loop) { onUpdate(0); return () => {}; }

  let stopped = false;
  let paused = 0;
  const unsub = subscribe((time) => {
    if (stopped) return;
    if (!shouldRun()) { if (start !== null && !paused) paused = time; return; }
    if (paused) { start += time - paused; paused = 0; }
    if (start === null) start = time;
    let t = (time - start) / duration;
    if (t >= 1) {
      if (loop) { start += duration * Math.floor(t); t -= Math.floor(t); }
      else { onUpdate(1); stopped = true; unsub(); onDone && onDone(); return; }
    }
    onUpdate(easing(t));
  }, () => 0);
  return () => { stopped = true; unsub(); };
}

/* =====================================================================
   4. SCROLL TRIGGERS, GATES & TEXT REVEALS
   ===================================================================== */
const scrollSubs = new Set();
let scrollQueued = false;
window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
  if (scrollQueued) return;
  scrollQueued = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => { scrollQueued = false; for (const fn of scrollSubs) fn(); });
}, { passive: true });

/* the trigger set — one ticker subscription at 10ms, each trigger gated by in-view + 10 frames */
const triggers = new Set();
let triggerUnsub = null;
function triggerFrame() {
  const vh = window.innerHeight;
  for (const t of triggers) {
    if (t.live <= 0) continue;
    if (!t.inView) t.live -= 1;
    const bb = t.el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const poses = {
      top_top: bb.top, center_top: bb.top + bb.height / 2, bottom_top: bb.bottom,
      top_bottom: bb.top - vh, center_bottom: bb.top + bb.height / 2 - vh, bottom_bottom: bb.bottom - vh,
      top_center: bb.top - vh / 2, center_center: bb.top + bb.height / 2 - vh / 2, bottom_center: bb.bottom - vh / 2,
    };
    const scrollStart = poses[t.start];
    const scrollEnd = poses[t.end];
    const length = Math.max(1e-6, Math.abs(scrollStart - scrollEnd));
    const progress = Math.min(Math.max(0, 1 - (scrollStart + length) / length), 1);
    if (t.mode === "toggle") t.apply(progress >= 1 ? 1 : 0);
    else t.apply(progress);
  }
}
function scrollTrigger(el, start, end, apply, mode = "scrub") {
  const t = { el, start: start.replace(" ", "_"), end: end.replace(" ", "_"), apply, mode, inView: false, live: 10 };

    for (const e of entries) { t.inView = e.isIntersecting; if (e.isIntersecting) t.live = 10; }
  }, { rootMargin: "0px" });
  io.observe(el);
  triggers.add(t);
  if (!triggerUnsub) triggerUnsub = subscribe(triggerFrame, () => 10);

  requestAnimationFrame(() => { t.live = Math.max(t.live, 2); });
  return { trigger: t, destroy() { io.disconnect(); triggers.delete(t); } };

/* parse "<number><unit>" */

  const m1 = /^(-?[\d.]+)(.*)$/.exec(String(from));
  const m2 = /^(-?[\d.]+)(.*)$/.exec(String(to));
  return `${+m1[1] + (+m2[1] - +m1[1]) * p}${m1[2]}`;

function parallaxTop(layer, host, start, end, fromStr, toStr) {
  return scrollTrigger(host, start, end, (p) => { layer.style.top = lerpUnit(fromStr, toStr, p); });
}

/* gates */
const heroGate = { on: false, listeners: new Set() };
function openHeroGate() { heroGate.on = true; for (const fn of heroGate.listeners) fn(); }
function makeGate(kind, el, rootMargin) {
  if (kind === "hero") {
    return { get on() { return heroGate.on; }, listen(fn) { heroGate.listeners.add(fn); }, destroy() {} };
  }
  if (kind === "mount") return { on: true, listen() {}, destroy() {} };

    for (const e of entries) {
      gate.on = e.isIntersecting;
      for (const fn of gate.fns) fn();

  return gate;
}

function makeOnceGate(el, rootMargin) {
  const gate = { on: false, fns: new Set(), listen(fn) { this.fns.add(fn); } };
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.isIntersecting && !gate.on) { gate.on = true; for (const fn of gate.fns) fn(); io.disconnect(); }
    }
  }, { rootMargin: rootMargin || "0px" });
  io.observe(el);
  gate.destroy = () => io.disconnect();

}

/* a reveal may be gated on an ancestor (row, strip, block) */

/* mode logic: always | once | forward */
function modeController(el, gate, mode, setActive) {
  let fired = false;
  let current = null;
  const evaluate = () => {
    const gateOn = gate.on;
    let active;
    if (mode === "once") { if (gateOn) fired = true; active = fired; }

      const scrolledDown = el.getBoundingClientRect().top <= 0;
      active = gateOn || (fired && scrolledDown);

/* shared chequered dissolve (the seam) */
function createSeam(host, carry, cellSize = 24) {
  const canvas = host.querySelector("canvas");
  const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const SOLID_UNTIL = 0.16, LIFT = 2, ACCENT_SHARE = 0.06;
  const noise = (x, y) => {
    let h = Math.imul(x, 374761393) + Math.imul(y, 668265263);
    h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);
    return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967295;
  };
  let progress = 0;
  const accent = readToken("--accent");
  const surface = readToken(carry === "light" ? "--background" : "--surface-black");
  const render = () => {
    const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    const width = host.clientWidth, height = host.clientHeight;
    if (!width || !height) return;
    const bw = Math.round(width * ratio), bh = Math.round(height * ratio);
    if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) { canvas.width = bw; canvas.height = bh; }
    context.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    context.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    const cs = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(host).getPropertyValue("--flag-cell")) || cellSize;
    const columns = Math.ceil(width / cs), rows = Math.ceil(height / cs), lift = progress * LIFT;
    for (let y = 0; y < rows; y += 1) {
      const depth = y / Math.max(1, rows - 1) + lift;
      if (depth > 1) break;
      const solid = depth <= SOLID_UNTIL;
      const fade = clamp01(1 - (depth - SOLID_UNTIL) / (1 - SOLID_UNTIL));
      if (!solid && fade <= 0) break;
      for (let x = 0; x < columns; x += 1) {
        if (!solid) {
          if ((x + y) % 2 !== 0) continue;
          if (noise(x, y) > fade) continue;
        }
        context.fillStyle = !solid && noise(x + 101, y + 57) < ACCENT_SHARE ? accent : surface;
        context.fillRect(x * cs, y * cs, cs, cs);
      }
    }
  };
  const spring = new Spring(0, CFG.TRIGGER, (v) => { progress = v; render(); });
  scrollTrigger(host, "top bottom", "top top", (p) => spring.to(p));
  new ResizeObserver(render).observe(host);
  render();
  return { render };
}

    this.samples = this._tier.trailSamples;
    this.trail = Array.from({ length: this.samples }, () => new Vector2(STATIC_POSE.x, -STATIC_POSE.y));
    this.sweepTrail = Array.from({ length: this.samples }, () => new Vector2(AUTO_SWEEP_PATH[0].x, -AUTO_SWEEP_PATH[0].y));
    this.renderer = new WebGLRenderer({
      canvas, alpha: false, antialias: this._tier.antialias, stencil: false,
      powerPreference: this._tier.mobile ? "default" : "high-performance",
    });
    this.renderer.setClearColor(new Color(getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor));
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, this._tier.maxDpr));
    this.renderer.toneMapping = ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    if (!this._tier.pointerEnabled) this.parkPointer();
    this.camera.position.set(0, CAMERA_Y, 6.5);
    this.helmetGroup.add(this.helmetPivot);
    this.subjectGroup.add(this.helmetGroup);
    this.scene.add(this.subjectGroup);
    this.load().catch((err) => {
      console.error("[scene] load failed", err);
      if (this.onError) this.onError(err);
    });
  }

  get tier() { return this._tier; }

  retune() {
    const fresh = getSceneTier();
    const previous = this._tier;
    const tier = { ...fresh, antialias: previous.antialias, trailSamples: previous.trailSamples };
    this._tier = tier;
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, tier.maxDpr));
    if (this.outlineMesh) this.outlineMesh.visible = tier.outline;
    if (!tier.pointerEnabled) this.parkPointer();
    else if (!previous.pointerEnabled) this.pointerSeen = false;
    if (!tier.freeze) this.settled = false;
    return tier;
  }

  parkPointer() {
    this.pointer = { ...STATIC_POSE };
    this.smoothed = { ...STATIC_POSE };
    this.lastSmoothed = { ...STATIC_POSE };
    this.tilt = this.pitchFor(STATIC_POSE.y);
    this.yaw = this.yawFor(STATIC_POSE.x);
    this.pointerSeen = false;
  }

  beginRise() { this.riseStarted = true; }

  setPointer(x, y) {
    this.pointer.x = x; this.pointer.y = y;
    if (!this.pointerSeen) {
      this.pointerSeen = true;
      this.smoothed.x = x; this.smoothed.y = y;
      this.lastSmoothed.x = x; this.lastSmoothed.y = y;
      this.tilt = this.pitchFor(y); this.yaw = this.yawFor(x);
    }
  }

  pitchFor(y) { return swing(y, this.params.helmetAmpX, this.params.helmetCurveX); }
  yawFor(x) { return swing(x, this.params.helmetAmpY, this.params.helmetCurveY); }

  setParams(partial) { Object.assign(this.params, partial); this.settled = false; }

  resize(width, height) {
    this.renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
    this.viewportHeight = Math.max(height, 1);
    this.viewportWidth = Math.max(width, 1);
    this.aspect = width / height;
    this.camera.aspect = this.aspect;
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    if (this.revealUniforms) this.revealUniforms.uAspect.value = this.aspect;
    this.settled = false;
  }

  update(time) {
    if (this.disposed || this.settled) return;
    if (this.startTime === null) this.startTime = time;
    const t = (time - this.startTime) / 1000;
    const p = this.params;

    if (this._tier.freeze && this.reveal > 0.995 && this.intro >= 1) this.settled = true;

    const autoEnabled = p.autoSweepAmount > 0 && !this._tier.freeze && this.intro >= 1;
    if (autoEnabled) {
      const cycle = t % Math.max(p.autoSweepPeriod, 0.001);
      if (cycle < this.sweepCycle) this.resetSweep();
      this.sweepCycle = cycle;
      const legs = AUTO_SWEEP_PATH.length - 1;
      const stroke = Math.max(p.autoSweepStroke, 0.05);
      const slot = stroke + Math.max(p.autoSweepHold, 0);
      const leg = Math.floor(cycle / slot);
      if (leg < legs) {
        const local = Math.min(1, (cycle - leg * slot) / stroke);
        const eased = 1 - (1 - local) * (1 - local);
        const from = AUTO_SWEEP_PATH[leg];
        const to = AUTO_SWEEP_PATH[leg + 1];
        this.sweepPointer.x = (from.x + (to.x - from.x) * eased) * p.autoSweepAmount;
        this.sweepPointer.y = (from.y + (to.y - from.y) * eased) * p.autoSweepAmount;
      }
    }
    this.sweepSmoothed.x += (this.sweepPointer.x - this.sweepSmoothed.x) * p.pointerLerp;
    this.sweepSmoothed.y += (this.sweepPointer.y - this.sweepSmoothed.y) * p.pointerLerp;
    const sweepStep = Math.hypot(this.sweepSmoothed.x - this.sweepLast.x, this.sweepSmoothed.y - this.sweepLast.y);
    const sweepTarget = autoEnabled ? Math.min(1, sweepStep / Math.max(p.pacePeak, 1e-5)) : 0;
    this.sweepPace += (sweepTarget - this.sweepPace) * (sweepTarget > this.sweepPace ? p.paceAttack : p.paceRelease);
    this.sweepLast.x = this.sweepSmoothed.x; this.sweepLast.y = this.sweepSmoothed.y;
    const oldestSweep = this.sweepTrail.pop();
    if (oldestSweep) { oldestSweep.set(this.sweepSmoothed.x, -this.sweepSmoothed.y); this.sweepTrail.unshift(oldestSweep); }

    this.smoothed.x += (this.pointer.x - this.smoothed.x) * p.pointerLerp;
    this.smoothed.y += (this.pointer.y - this.smoothed.y) * p.pointerLerp;

    if (this.ready) {
      if (this.readyAt === null) this.readyAt = t;
      this.intro = Math.min(1, (t - this.readyAt) / Math.max(p.introDuration, 0.001));
      if (this._tier.freeze) this.intro = 1;
    }

    this.camera.position.z = p.cameraZ;
    this.subjectGroup.scale.setScalar(p.subjectScale * this.narrowFit());
    this.subjectGroup.position.x = p.subjectX +
      (this.viewportWidth < STEP_UNDER && this.aspect >= 1.2 ? NARROW_STEP : 0) +
      this.smoothed.x * p.subjectParallax;
    this.subjectGroup.position.y = p.subjectY - this.smoothed.y * p.subjectParallax - this.riseOffset(t, p);

    if (this.headMaterial) {
      this.headMaterial.uniforms.uParallax.value.set(this.smoothed.x, -this.smoothed.y);
      this.headMaterial.uniforms.uReveal.value = this.reveal * clamp01(this.intro * 2.5);
      this.headMaterial.uniforms.uDepthScale.value = p.headParallax;
      this.headMaterial.uniforms.uRelight.value = p.headRelight;
    }
    if (this.headMesh) {
      this.headMesh.scale.setScalar(p.headScale);
      this.headMesh.position.y = -0.55 + p.headY - (HEAD_HEIGHT * HEAD_EXTEND * p.headScale) / 2;
    }

    this.tilt += (this.pitchFor(this.smoothed.y) - this.tilt) * p.pointerLerp;
    this.yaw += (this.yawFor(this.smoothed.x) - this.yaw) * p.pointerLerp;
    this.helmetPivot.rotation.x = this.tilt;
    this.helmetPivot.rotation.y = this.yaw;
    this.helmetGroup.position.x = p.helmetX + this.smoothed.x * p.helmetFollow;
    this.helmetGroup.position.y = p.helmetY - this.smoothed.y * p.helmetFollow * 0.8;
    this.helmetGroup.position.z = p.helmetZ;
    this.helmetGroup.scale.setScalar(p.helmetScale);

    const step = Math.hypot(this.smoothed.x - this.lastSmoothed.x, this.smoothed.y - this.lastSmoothed.y);
    if (this._tier.pointerEnabled) {
      const target = Math.min(1, step / Math.max(p.pacePeak, 1e-5));
      this.pace += (target - this.pace) * (target > this.pace ? p.paceAttack : p.paceRelease);
    } else if (!autoEnabled && this.intro >= 1 && this._tier.reveal) {
      this.pace = 1;
    }
    this.lastSmoothed.x = this.smoothed.x; this.lastSmoothed.y = this.smoothed.y;

    const oldest = this.trail.pop();
    if (oldest) { oldest.set(this.smoothed.x, -this.smoothed.y); this.trail.unshift(oldest); }

    if (this.revealUniforms) {
      const u = this.revealUniforms;
      u.uAspect.value = this.aspect; u.uRadius.value = p.trailRadius; u.uIdleScale.value = p.trailIdleScale;
      u.uTaper.value = p.trailTaper; u.uTaperIdle.value = p.trailTaperIdle; u.uTaperFast.value = p.trailTaperFast;
      u.uLength.value = p.trailLength; u.uPace.value = this.pace; u.uGateStart.value = p.paceThreshold;
      u.uGateWidth.value = p.paceRamp; u.uWarpScale.value = p.revealWarpScale;
      u.uTime.value = t * p.revealSpeed; u.uRevealMix.value = this.reveal;
      u.uThreshold.value = p.revealThreshold; u.uEdge.value = p.revealEdge; u.uWarp.value = p.revealWarp;
      u.uIntro.value = this.intro; u.uBurnStart.value = p.burnStart; u.uBurnSoft.value = p.burnSoftness;
      u.uBurnGlow.value = p.burnGlow;
      u.uSweepPace.value = this.sweepPace; u.uSweepWarp.value = p.sweepWarp;
      u.uSweepLength.value = p.sweepLength; u.uSweepRadius.value = p.sweepRadius;
      this.writeTrailBounds(this.trail, p.trailLength, p.revealWarp, p.trailRadius, u.uTrailMin.value, u.uTrailMax.value);
      this.writeTrailBounds(this.sweepTrail, p.sweepLength, p.sweepWarp, p.sweepRadius, u.uSweepMin.value, u.uSweepMax.value);
    }

    if (this.backdropMesh && this.backdropMaterial) {
      const distance = this.camera.position.z - BACKDROP_Z;
      const height = 2 * distance * Math.tan((this.camera.fov * Math.PI) / 360) * 1.06;
      this.backdropMesh.scale.set(height * this.aspect, height, 1);
      const bg = this.backdropMaterial.uniforms;
      bg.uLineScale.value = p.bgLineScale; bg.uLineCount.value = p.bgLineCount;
      bg.uLineThickness.value = p.bgLineThickness; bg.uLineOpacity.value = p.bgLineOpacity;
      bg.uWaveAmount.value = p.bgWaveAmount; bg.uWaveSpeed.value = p.bgWaveSpeed;
      bg.uRevealOpacity.value = p.bgRevealOpacity;
      bg.uRevealColor.value.setScalar(p.bgRevealLightness);
      bg.uRevealColorAlt.value.setScalar(p.bgRevealLightnessAlt);
    }

    if (this.outlineMaterial) {
      const o = this.outlineMaterial.uniforms;
      o.uTime.value = t; o.uPeriod.value = p.outlinePeriod; o.uStagger.value = p.outlineStagger;
      o.uOpacity.value = p.outlineOpacity; o.uWidth.value = p.outlineWidth;
      o.uLightness.value = p.outlineLightness; o.uBase.value = p.outlineBase;
      o.uRevealMix.value = this.reveal * this.burnProgress(p);
    }
    if (this.shellMaterial) this.shellMaterial.color.setScalar(p.helmetBrightness);
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
  }

  riseOffset(t, p) {
    if (this._tier.freeze || p.riseDistance === 0) return 0;
    let remaining = 1;
    if (this.riseStarted) {
      if (this.riseAt === null) this.riseAt = t;
      const u = Math.min(1, (t - this.riseAt) / Math.max(p.riseDuration, 0.001));
      remaining = 1 - (1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u));
    }
    if (remaining <= 0) return 0;
    const visible = 2 * p.cameraZ * Math.tan((this.camera.fov * Math.PI) / 360);
    return remaining * p.riseDistance * (visible / this.viewportHeight);
  }

  burnProgress(p) {
    const span = Math.max(1 - p.burnStart, 1e-4);
    const x = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (this.intro - p.burnStart) / span));
    return x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
  }

  resetSweep() {
    const start = AUTO_SWEEP_PATH[0];
    const amount = this.params.autoSweepAmount;
    const x = start.x * amount, y = start.y * amount;
    this.sweepPointer.x = x; this.sweepPointer.y = y;
    this.sweepSmoothed.x = x; this.sweepSmoothed.y = y;
    this.sweepLast.x = x; this.sweepLast.y = y;
    this.sweepPace = 0;
    for (const sample of this.sweepTrail) sample.set(x, -y);
  }

  narrowFit() {
    if (this.viewportWidth >= PORT_WIDTH) return 1;
    if (this.aspect < 1.2) return 1;
    return Math.max(MIN_FIT, Math.min(1, this.aspect / REFERENCE_ASPECT));
  }

  writeTrailBounds(trail, length, warp, radius, min, max) {
    const active = Math.min(trail.length, Math.ceil(length * (this.samples - 1)) + 1);
    const margin = radius + warp * 0.22 + 0.05;
    let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < active; i++) {
      const sample = trail[i];
      const x = sample.x * this.aspect;
      if (x < minX) minX = x;
      if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
      if (sample.y < minY) minY = sample.y;
      if (sample.y > maxY) maxY = sample.y;
    }
    min.set(minX - margin, minY - margin);
    max.set(maxX + margin, maxY + margin);
  }

  dispose() {
    this.disposed = true;
    this.scene.traverse((object) => {
      if (object.geometry) object.geometry.dispose();
      const materials = Array.isArray(object.material) ? object.material : [object.material];
      for (const material of materials) {
        if (!material) continue;
        for (const value of Object.values(material)) if (value instanceof Texture) value.dispose();
        material.dispose();
      }
    });
    this.renderer.dispose();
  }

  async load() {
    const textureLoader = new TextureLoader();
    textureLoader.setCrossOrigin("anonymous");
    const loadTexture = (file, srgb = false) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const url = `${SCENE_ASSETS}/${file}`;
        textureLoader.load(url, (texture) => {
          if (srgb) texture.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace;
          texture.minFilter = LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
          texture.generateMipmaps = true;
          resolve(texture);
        }, undefined, (err) => { reportAssetError(url, err); reject(new Error(`texture failed: ${url}`)); });
      });
    const guard = (url, promise) => promise.catch((err) => { reportAssetError(url, err); throw err; });

    const maps = await Promise.all([
      loadTexture("person-diffuse.webp", true), loadTexture("person-depth.webp"),
      loadTexture("person-alpha.webp"), loadTexture("person-normal.webp"), loadTexture("noise.webp"),
      loadTexture("alt-diffuse.webp", true), loadTexture("alt-alpha.webp"),
    ]);
    const noise = maps[4];
    let helmetGltf = null;
    if (HELMET_URL) {
      const [{ GLTFLoader }, { DRACOLoader }, { RGBELoader }, { mergeGeometries }] = await Promise.all([
        import("three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js"), import("three/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader.js"),
        import("three/addons/loaders/RGBELoader.js"), import("three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js"),
      ]);
      this.mergeGeometries = mergeGeometries;
      const dracoLoader = new DRACOLoader();
      dracoLoader.setDecoderPath(DRACO_DECODER_PATH);
      const gltfLoader = new GLTFLoader();
      gltfLoader.setCrossOrigin("anonymous");
      gltfLoader.setDRACOLoader(dracoLoader);
      const rgbe = new RGBELoader();
      rgbe.setCrossOrigin("anonymous");
      const [env, gltf] = await Promise.all([
        guard(`${SCENE_ASSETS}/${ENV_URL}`, rgbe.loadAsync(`${SCENE_ASSETS}/${ENV_URL}`)),
        guard(`${SCENE_ASSETS}/${HELMET_URL}`, gltfLoader.loadAsync(`${SCENE_ASSETS}/${HELMET_URL}`)),
      ]);
      if (this.disposed) return;
      const pmrem = new PMREMGenerator(this.renderer);
      this.scene.environment = pmrem.fromEquirectangular(env).texture;
      env.dispose();
      pmrem.dispose();
      helmetGltf = gltf;
    }
    if (this.disposed) return;

    this.buildRevealUniforms(noise);
    this.buildHead(maps[0], maps[1], maps[2], maps[3], maps[5], maps[6]);
    if (helmetGltf) this.buildHelmet(helmetGltf.scene);
    this.buildBackdrop(noise);
    this.reveal = 1;

    for (const texture of [...maps, ...this.helmetTextures]) this.renderer.initTexture(texture);
    await this.renderer.compileAsync(this.scene, this.camera);
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
    this.ready = true;
    if (this.onReady) this.onReady();
  }

  buildHead(diffuse, depth, alpha, normal, altDiffuse, altAlpha) {
    this.headMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      vertexShader: headVertex, fragmentShader: buildHeadFragment(this.samples),
      uniforms: {
        uDiffuse: { value: diffuse }, uDepth: { value: depth }, uAlpha: { value: alpha }, uNormal: { value: normal },
        uParallax: { value: new Vector2() }, uReveal: { value: 0 },
        uDepthScale: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.headParallax }, uRelight: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.headRelight },
        uExtend: { value: HEAD_EXTEND },
        ...this.revealUniforms,
        uAltDiffuse: { value: altDiffuse }, uAltAlpha: { value: altAlpha }, uAltOn: { value: 1 },
      },
      transparent: true,
    });
    const geometry = new PlaneGeometry(HEAD_HEIGHT, HEAD_HEIGHT * (1 + HEAD_EXTEND));
    const head = new Mesh(geometry, this.headMaterial);
    head.position.set(0, -0.55, 0);
    this.headMesh = head;
    this.subjectGroup.add(head);
  }

  buildRevealUniforms(noise) {
    noise.wrapS = RepeatWrapping;
    noise.wrapT = RepeatWrapping;
    this.revealUniforms = {
      uTrail: { value: this.trail }, uTrailMin: { value: new Vector2(-1e3, -1e3) }, uTrailMax: { value: new Vector2(1e3, 1e3) },
      uSweep: { value: this.sweepTrail }, uSweepMin: { value: new Vector2(-1e3, -1e3) }, uSweepMax: { value: new Vector2(1e3, 1e3) },
      uSweepPace: { value: 0 }, uSweepWarp: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.sweepWarp },
      uSweepLength: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.sweepLength }, uSweepRadius: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.sweepRadius },
      uAspect: { value: this.aspect }, uRadius: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.trailRadius },
      uIdleScale: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.trailIdleScale }, uTaper: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.trailTaper },
      uTaperIdle: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.trailTaperIdle }, uTaperFast: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.trailTaperFast },
      uLength: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.trailLength }, uPace: { value: 0 },
      uGateStart: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.paceThreshold }, uGateWidth: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.paceRamp },
      uWarpScale: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.revealWarpScale }, uTime: { value: 0 },
      uThreshold: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.revealThreshold }, uEdge: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.revealEdge },
      uWarp: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.revealWarp }, uRevealMix: { value: 0 }, uNoiseTex: { value: noise },
      uIntro: { value: 0 }, uBurnStart: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.burnStart }, uBurnSoft: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.burnSoftness },
      uBurnGlow: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.burnGlow }, uBurnColor: { value: new Color(readToken("--accent")) },
    };
  }

  buildHelmet(root) {
    root.traverse((object) => {
      if (!object.isMesh) return;
      const mesh = object;
      const shell = mesh.material;
      shell.side = FrontSide;
      shell.transparent = true;
      shell.depthWrite = false;
      shell.envMapIntensity = 1.3;
      this.injectRevealMask(shell);
      mesh.renderOrder = 1;
      this.shellMaterial = shell;
      for (const map of [shell.map, shell.normalMap, shell.roughnessMap, shell.metalnessMap]) {
        if (map && !this.helmetTextures.includes(map)) this.helmetTextures.push(map);
      }
    });
    const bounds = new Box3().setFromObject(root);
    const size = bounds.getSize(new Vector3());
    const scale = (HEAD_HEIGHT * 0.56) / size.y;
    root.scale.setScalar(scale);
    bounds.setFromObject(root);
    const center = bounds.getCenter(new Vector3());
    root.position.sub(center);
    this.helmetPivot.position.copy(HELMET_WORN_OFFSET);
    this.helmetPivot.add(root);
    this.helmetGroup.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    this.buildOutline(root);
  }

  buildOutline(root) {
    const toGroupLocal = this.helmetPivot.matrixWorld.clone().invert();
    const geometries = [];
    root.traverse((object) => {
      const mesh = object;
      if (!mesh.isMesh || !mesh.visible || !mesh.geometry) return;
      const geometry = mesh.geometry.clone();
      geometry.applyMatrix4(new Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(toGroupLocal, mesh.matrixWorld));
      for (const name of Object.keys(geometry.attributes)) if (name !== "position") geometry.deleteAttribute(name);
      geometries.push(geometry);
    });
    if (!geometries.length) return;
    const merged = this.mergeGeometries ? this.mergeGeometries(geometries, false) : null;
    for (const geometry of geometries) geometry.dispose();
    if (!merged) return;
    merged.computeBoundingBox();
    const bounds = merged.boundingBox;
    const minY = bounds ? bounds.min.y : 0;
    const rangeY = bounds ? bounds.max.y - bounds.min.y : 1;
    this.outlineMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      vertexShader: outlineVertex, fragmentShader: outlineFragment, wireframe: true, transparent: true, depthWrite: false,
      uniforms: {
        uTime: { value: 0 }, uPeriod: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.outlinePeriod }, uStagger: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.outlineStagger },
        uOpacity: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.outlineOpacity }, uWidth: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.outlineWidth },
        uLightness: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.outlineLightness }, uBase: { value: DEFAULT_PARAMS.outlineBase },
        uRevealMix: { value: 0 }, uColor: { value: new Color(readToken("--foreground")) },
        uMinY: { value: minY }, uRangeY: { value: rangeY },
      },
    });
    const outline = new Mesh(merged, this.outlineMaterial);
    outline.renderOrder = 3;
    outline.visible = this._tier.outline;
    this.outlineMesh = outline;
    this.helmetPivot.add(outline);
  }

  injectRevealMask(material) {
    const uniforms = this.revealUniforms;
    if (!uniforms) return;
    material.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
      Object.assign(shader.uniforms, uniforms);
      shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader
        .replace("#include <common>", "#include <common>\nvarying vec4 vRevealClip;")
        .replace("#include <project_vertex>", "#include <project_vertex>\nvRevealClip = gl_Position;");
      shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
        .replace("#include <common>", `#include <common>
           varying vec4 vRevealClip;
           uniform float uIntro;
           uniform float uBurnStart;
           uniform float uBurnSoft;
           uniform float uBurnGlow;
           uniform vec3 uBurnColor;
           ${buildRevealDeclarations(this.samples)}`)
        .replace("#include <alphamap_fragment>", `#include <alphamap_fragment>
           vec2 revealNdc = vRevealClip.xy / vRevealClip.w;
           float burnFront = smoothstep(uBurnStart, 1.0, uIntro);
           float burnNoise = texture2D(uNoiseTex, revealNdc * 0.5 + 0.5).r;
           float burnHeight = 1.0 - (revealNdc.y * 0.5 + 0.5);
           float burnAt = mix(burnHeight, burnNoise, 0.45);
           float intact = smoothstep(burnFront - uBurnSoft, burnFront + uBurnSoft, burnAt);
           float mask = max(revealTrail(revealNdc), intact);
           diffuseColor.a *= mask * uRevealMix;
           float burnEdge = 4.0 * intact * (1.0 - intact);
           diffuseColor.rgb += uBurnColor * burnEdge * uBurnGlow * uRevealMix;`);
    };
  }

  buildBackdrop(noise) {
    const uniforms = this.revealUniforms;

function supportsWebGL() {
